title: Build the exact sawtooth network
brief: Implement the activations and a general forward pass, then build the exact weights that carve 2^k linear pieces out of a depth-k ReLU network.
hints: The tent map T(x) = 2 min(x, 1 - x) equals 2 relu(x) - 4 relu(x - 1/2) on [0, 1]: check both pieces algebraically.

sawtooth_network's later layers must fold the previous layer's combination 2 h1 - 4 h2 into the next layer's weight matrix, since a plain list of affine-then-relu layers has no separate 'combine' step.

count_linear_regions_1d: within one interval, every unit's pre-activation is an affine function of x, so a zero crossing inside the interval is where slope * x + intercept = 0; only count it if it lands strictly inside the interval's open bounds.
flop_count: a matrix-vector product with W of shape (out, in) costs 2 * in * out flops for the multiply-adds, plus out for the bias.
